title: Clay Atelier
alt: Light-filled ceramics workshop with pale timber beams, a long oak making table and handmade vessels
overview: An imagined ceramics studio where making and displaying share the same generous room. North light, useful surfaces and an honest material palette form a calm backdrop to the mess and repetition of craft.
approach: The work table sits at the centre of the plan. Open shelving gives unfinished pieces space to rest, and a low courtyard threshold offers a place to pause. Pale timber and limewashed brick are chosen to age alongside daily use, without demanding perfection.
